evaluation_protocol: Held-out synthetic test set with separate random seed (999). Evaluated unsupervised Isolation Forest decision threshold (-1 -> 1, 1 -> 0).
scientific_limitations: CRITICAL NOTE: These metrics reflect performance strictly against synthetic behavioral distributions designed to model ransomware properties. Real-world malware environments feature diverse legitimate enterprise workloads, evasion techniques (slow encryption, process injection), and legitimate high-throughput programs that would induce different false positive and false negative dynamics.
